description: Run arbitrary shell command with user-supplied var — T5 deny

playbook.content:
- name: Run admin command
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.shell:
        cmd: '{{ admin_command }}'

tier_rationale: shell module with user-supplied variable is a T5 violation
common_mistakes: ansible-lint: may flag as risky but not deny-level
